name: Cash Balance 14
definition: Balance details for a cash account.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the nature of a balance.

CounterpartyType.name: Counterparty Type
CounterpartyType.definition: Specifies the type of counterparty for which the balance is calculated.

CounterpartyIdentification.name: Counterparty Identification
CounterpartyIdentification.definition: Specifies the counterparty for which the balance is calculated.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time at which the balance is or will be available.

ProcessingDate.name: Processing Date
ProcessingDate.definition: Date or date time when the balance was last updated following an entry posted to the account, in the books of the account servicing institution.

CounterpartyIdentification1Rule.definition: If at least one occurrence of CounterpartyType is present and is equal to Multilateral (MULT), then no occurrence of CounterpartyIdentification is allowed.|If CounterpartyType is not present, then any occurrence of CounterpartyIdentification is optional.

CounterpartyIdentification2Rule.definition: If at least one occurrence of CounterpartyType is present and is equal to Bilateral (BILA), then at least one occurrence of CounterpartyIdentification must be present.|If CounterpartyType is not present, then any occurrence of CounterpartyIdentification is optional.
